<div class="card-body">
'''Wampa''' is a [[Dark]] [[Creature]] ([[Creature]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ワンパ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊凶暴性＝3＋運命数。生息地：ホスの位置。「ワンパの雪洞」か未踏査のマーカー位置にのみ配備する。負けたキャラクターは食べられるか、あるいは「ワンパの雪洞」に移される（犠牲者の相手プレイヤーが選択する）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Wampa-PSA-92654369.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">雪に被われたツンドラを徘徊する狡猾な肉食獣。ワンパはしばしば獲物を自分の巣に持ち帰って保存する。屍肉よりも生きたままの獲物を好んでむさぼり食うのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Wampa.

'''Card text:''' * Ferocity = 3 + destiny. Habitat: Hoth locations. Deploy only to Wampa Cave or an unexplored marker location. A defeated character is eaten or moved to Wampa Cave. The victim's opponent chooses.

Printed subtype is 寒冷地生物, not Snow. Habitat uses 位置. Deploy restriction uses 未踏査 rather than unoccupied. Vicious Howl is printed 血も凍る叫び声 3. Lore prints 被われた.

'''Lore:''' A cunning carnivore that prowls snow-covered tundra. Wampas often drag prey to their dens for storage. They prefer to devour living prey rather than carrion.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 寒冷地生物, not Snow.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Wampa]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
